international.summary: HMCS Spitfire was commissioned by colonial government to protect against Russian warships during the Crimean war The wreck of Australia’s first locally built warship has been discovered 128 years after sinking off the coast of far north Queensland. Marine archaeologists found the remains of Ex HMCS Spitfire on 21 August, the anniversary of its sinking in 1898. Continue reading...
